svg.aria-label: First contact: email, video and booking a call
svg.title: First contact: email, video and booking a call
svg.text: Hi Craig. I rang Wrenfield three times last week as if I were a customer. Two went
unanswered, including 08:12 on Tuesday. I also saw you’re hiring a part-time
I build systems that answer every call, put the job straight into ServiceM8 and get
quotes out the same day, so that hire may not be needed.
Mind if I send a 2-minute video of what I found?
Ryan, Halyard Automation · reply “stop” and I won’t email again
Go on then, send it. Phones are a nightmare.
Watched it in the van. Can you do Wednesday after 7?
